extracted.intended_audience: poets and writers submitting poems, visual/video poems, or prose to Poetry magazine
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for submitting poetry, visual/video poems, and prose to Poetry magazine via Submittable, including eligibility, timing, simultaneous-submission policy, and payment rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission platform (Submittable)
rubrics_metrics.description: Please visit our Submittable page for our full submission guidelines and open calls for work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instructions and guides for using Submittable are available on their website. If you’re having technical issues with Submittable, please contact support@submittable.com.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response time
rubrics_metrics.description: We receive more than 100,000 poems each year. Due to the volume of submissions and our small staff, response time is up to eight months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect long delays; the magazine asks for patience and sets expectation of up to eight months for a response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual closed submission period
rubrics_metrics.description: We close for submissions from June 15 to September 15 annually.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions submitted during this closed window will not be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: One submission at a time per category
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send only one submission at a time per category and wait until you receive a response before uploading a new submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not upload additional submissions in the same category while a submission is under consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional submissions archived unread
rubrics_metrics.description: We are eager to provide ample time and space for everyone’s voices to be considered, so additional submissions will be archived unread and will receive no response.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you ignore the one-at-a-time rule, those extra submissions will not be read or answered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Previously unpublished work only
rubrics_metrics.description: We consider only previously unpublished work. Work that has appeared online for any reason, including social media posts, is considered previously published and should not be submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any prior online appearance (including social media) counts as publication and makes the work ineligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simultaneous submissions policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Poetry is open to simultaneous submissions but let us know immediately if work is accepted elsewhere by updating your submission with a message in Submittable stating that the work is no longer available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may submit the same piece elsewhere, but you must promptly update your Submittable submission if the piece is accepted by another outlet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment rates / compensation
rubrics_metrics.description: All published work will be compensated: Text poems: $10/line with a minimum payment of $400 per poem. Visual poems: $400 per poem. Video poems: $600 per poem. Prose: $250 per published page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Payments are specified by form; text-poem payments are per line with a floor, while visual/video and prose have fixed rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure you receive our response (email allowlist)
rubrics_metrics.description: To ensure you receive our response, set your spam filter to allow emails from submissions@poetrymagazine.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Whitelist the submissions email address so acceptance/rejection notices are not lost to spam.
